source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material annual snapshot, provisional, correction, transition, denominator, estimate or scope caveat

quality_guards: DWI 2025 results are an annual national and company-level snapshot, not live tap-level measurements.
Consumer distribution-system failures are separated from water-company network failures.
DWI compliance, CRI and ERI statistics are not converted into individual-property water quality.
CQC statutory notifications record changes and incidents but are not evidence of overall provider compliance.
CQC and NHS England information-sharing routes are kept separate from direct CQC notification duties.
Notifiable safety incident, Never Event and general patient safety event terms are not treated as interchangeable.
The current Never Events framework remains active while a replacement approach is still under development.
Corrected and provisional NHS patient-safety data is marked and not promoted to final.
Patient-safety event counts are not treated as rates without activity and reporting-context denominators.
RAIB full investigations, safety digests, industry reviews and no-action outcomes remain distinct triage categories.
RAIB recommendation statuses are reported by safety authorities or public bodies and can change.
AAIB notification totals are reporting activity rather than exposure-adjusted accident rates.
AAIB investigation classes and safety actions are not interpreted as equivalent severity or complete risk closure.
HSE's silica mortality figure is an estimated burden and not a current annual incident count.
CDM duties describe project and work-activity controls, not parcel-level inherent risk.
